memo: Helped: the batch change, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**18 (-0.0174, accepted), and doubling UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008 (-0.0108, accepted, replicated 1.0869/1.0859). Incumbent mean_adjusted is now 1.0864 over 2 runs. The longer warmdown (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.7, FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.05) scored 1.0871/1.0894 and was rejected (-0.0090 against the older incumbent). Small or neutral: SwiGLU (-0.0029), SSSSSSSL (-0.0036), gradient clipping (-0.0003). These were measured before the batch change, so they are unconfirmed.
